page.description: VyOS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An open-source router and firewall operating system built on Debian, configured entirely from a command-line interface and updated image by image.
pros: One CLI configures routing, firewalling, VPN and NAT.
Each version installs as its own image, so rollback is a reboot.
Three channels: rolling, Stream previews and LTS releases.
Runs on x86_64 hardware and common hypervisors.
cons: LTS images are distributed through the subscriber Support Portal.
Rolling and Stream builds are previews, not stable releases.
No desktop: it is a network appliance OS.
ROMinit pins no image here, because the LTS media is gated.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for VyOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: VyOS is installed by writing its ISO to a USB stick or by running it as a VM image. The 1.5.1 LTS images come from the subscriber Support Portal; the public channels are rolling and Stream previews, so ROMinit does not pin a file.
